How every course works

Built like my client work. Sized for one person.

The villain here is not a company or a competitor. It’s Someday: the launch date that never arrives. Every course is designed to beat it.

01

Install the skills once

You get my skills as one package. Install it in Claude (recommended) or ChatGPT and the AI builds with you, in your voice and your brand.

Out: an AI that knows your brand

02

Short lessons, real outputs

Every video is under 3 minutes and every lesson has a written guide with screenshots. Paste the prompt, check the result, save your progress.

Out: something you can show

03

A human checks your work

Every buyer gets a 1-hour review with me or my team. Questions get answered by real people, not a chatbot with a smile.

Out: a second pair of eyes

Questions

Before you grab a seat.

Straight answers. If yours isn’t here, ask me on LinkedIn.

When can I join?
Not on the Syllabus opens first, then SideGig, then the MainGig Playbook. Launch dates and founding seats are announced on LinkedIn first. Courses are sold and hosted on Whop under YJ Ventures.
Do I need to know how to code?
No. You need a laptop, a paid Claude or ChatGPT plan and a few focused hours. The AI writes the code; the lessons show you exactly what to paste and what to check.
Which course should I start with?
At uni, or just graduated, with an idea: Not on the Syllabus. Working a job and building on the side: SideGig. Already selling something and ready to grow it: the MainGig Playbook.
Will I make money?
I don’t promise income, and you should be wary of anyone who does. What I promise is the setup: you leave with a brand, an offer and the tools to launch it. The rest is the fun part, and it’s yours.
Is this for my company?
The courses are for individuals building their own thing. If your organisation needs private, governed AI, that’s my day job: book a strategy call.
Unplug the toaster

Your AI should live in your house. Let’s move it in.

45 minutes. Bring one problem: stalled pilots, a governance question, a board brief, data that can’t leave the country. Leave with the first move. If the answer is that you don’t need me, you’ll hear that too.
